about_the_game:
Concrete Spaces is an interactive poetry collection, that plays with creating and destroying spatial expectations, spoken word inspired pacing, and bilinguality.

Features:

  • 10 interactive audiovisual poems.

  • Implied, yet completely unforced linearity.

  • Mainly written in English, with some Finnish texts in the mix. (can be fully experienced without understanding the language)

  • A single playthrough taking 20-40 minutes, depending on your pace.

  • Optionless; windowed mode and keyboard input only.

Disclaimer:

These alt-games, art games, kill-gameplay-games, or whatever you'd like to call them, aren't exactly made to act as time-sinks ━ so if you're looking for that sort of stuff, this might not be for you... As this game was solo developed, there's still a possibility for bugs, if encountered, reload the currently open Space! Thanks.
